title: Pipedream Self Hosted: Options and Alternatives (2026)
summary: Pipedream self hosted doesn't exist—the platform is cloud-based only. Determine whether Pipedream's cloud features fit your integration needs.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions


None of this replaces reading those pages yourself; each answer below is limited to what Pipedream's own pages state.


### Hosting and deployment


Is there a free self-hosted version of Pipedream? No. Pipedream's docs describe no compose file, image or installer for its workflow platform, but confirm self-hosting on the vendor's pricing page.


Anyone offering you one is describing a different tool or an unofficial workaround, and you can't verify it against a vendor page.


Can I run Pipedream workflows in my own cloud account? Not as a documented, self-serve option. Workflows execute on Pipedream's infrastructure.


Any arrangement that changes where they run's a conversation with their sales team, and the terms exist only in the contract. Ask for the deployment diagram in writing before you plan around it.


### Plans, SSO and licensing


Does Pipedream offer SSO, and on which plan? Single sign-on's a feature of their higher paid tiers, not the free one.


Which tier, and at what price, 's on the pricing page, and that page changes. Read the plan comparison there and confirm identity-provider support against the security or docs pages, since "SSO" can mean SAML, OIDC or only social login.


Is Pipedream open source? Partly. The public GitHub repository holds the registry of prebuilt triggers and actions, and you can read that source tree.


### Keeping the answers current


How often should I re-check these claims? Re-check before every purchase decision and after any announced ownership or plan change, since hosting terms are exactly what an acquisition can alter.


Record the page address and the date you read it beside each answer, the way you would log a source for a change ticket. A claim without a date is one you can't verify later.
